seo.title: PLC, HMI & SCADA Platforms We Program | Logic Controls
seo.description: We program and integrate Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon PLCs and HMIs, plus drives, WinCC SCADA and Modbus.

h1: PLC, HMI and SCADA platforms we program and integrate
intro: We are not tied to one brand. We program and integrate five PLC and HMI platforms and choose the one that fits your machine, your budget and the spare parts you can get in Egypt.
Below are the platforms, drives, software and signals we work with, and the products we have used in recent projects.

brands.title: PLC and HMI platforms we program and integrate

siemens.text: S7-1200 PLCs with WinCC Professional SCADA for process machines and plants, as in our tablet coating and concrete batching projects, and with a SIMATIC HMI on our beverage syrup mixing system. We have also commissioned S7-200 SMART systems.

schneider-electric.text: PLCs, Altivar variable-speed drives, stepper drives, and protection and control components. Schneider Electric stepper drives run the label dispensing on our labeling machine.

delta.text: DVP-series PLCs for filling and labeling machines, chosen where a compact, cost-effective controller fits the job.

ls-electric.text: PLCs for filling machines and sterilization autoclaves, and M100 variable-speed drives.

wecon.text: PLCs and touch-screen HMIs used in most of our machine projects: pasteurizers, a cheese cooker, laundry washers, filling, labeling and test machines.

drives.title: Drives and motion
drives.text: Variable-speed drives for conveyors, pumps, mixers, drums and fans, and stepper and motion control for positioning and synchronization.
items: LS Electric M100 VFDs
Schneider Electric Altivar VFDs
VEICHI VFDs
Yaskawa VFDs
Schneider Electric stepper drives
PLC-based motion control for synchronized positioning

scada.title: Software, SCADA and data
scada.text: From electrical drawings in EPLAN Electric P8 to a single touch screen on a machine or a SCADA overview of a full process.
items: EPLAN Electric P8 for electrical design and panel drawings
Siemens WinCC Professional SCADA
SQL database integration for SCADA reports and OEE dashboards
Process mimics, recipes and alarm history on HMIs
Arabic, English and bilingual HMI screens
User log-in and access levels
Data logging and automatic test reports

networks.title: Communication
networks.text: We connect PLCs, HMIs, drives and instruments over common industrial networks. We check every device's interface before we quote.
items: Modbus RTU over RS-485
Modbus TCP
PROFINET for Siemens systems
Industrial Ethernet with managed and unmanaged switches

signals.title: Signals and instruments
items: Digital inputs and outputs: sensors, switches, valves and contactors
Analog signals: 4-20 mA and 0-10 V transmitters and positioners
Temperature sensors: RTD and thermocouple
Weighing with load cells for batching
Encoders and fast counters for length and position
Level, pressure and gas measurement on process systems

categories.title: Drives, SCADA, networks and signals
categories.intro: The controller is only one part of the system. These are the other layers we design, program and commission around it.

otherBrands.title: Other equipment we have worked with
otherBrands.text: On client machines we have also worked with MCGS HMIs, VEICHI and Yaskawa drives, MEAN WELL power supplies and industrial Ethernet switches. If your machine uses another brand, send us the model and we will tell you what we can do.

items.title: Spare parts in Egypt
items.text: A controller is only as good as the replacement you can buy when it fails.

items.title: Your budget
items.text: Cost-effective platforms for simple machines, and higher-end PLCs and SCADA where the process needs them.

items.title: Your team
items.text: If your maintenance team already knows one brand, we take that into account.

items.title: The machine builder's standard
items.text: For imported or OEM machines, we follow the platform the machine was designed for, unless there is a reason to change.
